intent: With the default config, every lane whose native hook can block a file edit runs the fail-open edit guard before the edit, while the advisory-only Antigravity lane never registers it.
outcome: Claude PreToolUse (Edit|Write|MultiEdit), Codex PreToolUse (apply_patch, with the Codex hooks feature on), and Gemini CLI BeforeTool (write_file, replace) run `auto guard edit` for their own platform through the exit-0 wrapper; the OpenCode plugin's before-hook spawns the guard for its file-editing tools; .agents/hooks.json names no guard.

assertions.value_contains: out=$(auto guard edit --platform claude-code) && [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 0
out=$(auto guard edit --platform codex) && [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 0
out=$(auto guard edit --platform gemini) && [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 0

provenance.ref: SPEC-EDITGUARD-001 REQ-EG-11 to REQ-EG-14 and REQ-EG-16; pkg/content/hooks_edit_guard.go, pkg/editguard/matrix.go, pkg/adapter/opencode/opencode_plugin.go
